core_overview.rationale: The overview's open_details gain two navigation entries and keep the four original anomalies. The first new entry names the four confirmed in-scope duties on the mapped paths (batching-FSM ConfigurationStore delivery, heartbeat fast-path header gate, TimeoutNow sender attribution, snapshot install log-tail alignment) as pointers to their claim/check records, with their residual premises; the second names the ReloadConfig and processHeartbeat leads. The formation, context and connection explanations, the status and the core_gaps are unchanged, and no finding is duplicated into the overview.

feedback.answered: The overview now navigates to the run's confirmed results instead of leaving them only in claim records. Four implementation-level duties on the mapped paths were confirmed in scope with complete witnesses: batching FSMs never receive ConfigurationStore.StoreConfiguration; the heartbeat fast path reaches appendEntries without checkRPCHeader while the normal path rejects the same request; TimeoutNow grants the pre-vote-skipping vote privilege to a sender the receiver's configuration does not contain; and an accepted InstallSnapshot retains and reports a log tail above the snapshot index. Two further areas were read and recorded without obligations (ReloadConfig's notification scope, processHeartbeat's concurrency contract), and three suspected defects were excluded by reading or by a local run (the protocol-version gate cannot underflow because the type is signed; liveBootstrap cannot bootstrap a node with existing state because BootstrapCluster refuses; FileSnapshotStore.List does not alias its metadata in this toolchain).
remaining: Residual premises of the confirmed findings: real-deployment reachability of an unconfigured TimeoutNow sender, the election/quorum consequence of the fast-path heartbeat, whether batching FSMs are contractually exempt from ConfigurationStore, and how long a snapshot-installed tail persists under a live leader.
ReloadConfig notification scope (only a decreased HeartbeatTimeout signals the notify channels) and the processHeartbeat concurrency contract remain leads/limits with no obligation.
Still unread: the in-memory snapshot store, observer plumbing, and net_transport beyond the heartbeat classification and the pipeline review.
feedback.rationale: Adding the pointers to open_details keeps one primary home per kind of knowledge: the claims, checks and assessments own the reasoning and evidence, while the overview owns navigation. The core_gaps stay empty because formation, authority transitions and their connection remain explained; the new entries are implementation-level residuals, not gaps in the core explanation.
